metadata.description: Claude Code skills, agents, and tooling for cybersecurity and GenAI security work.

plugins.name: security-diagramming
plugins.description: Attack trees, threat-model DFDs, architecture diagrams, mindmaps, and infographics for security work (Excalidraw-based).

plugins.name: security-reporting
plugins.description: Generate consistent findings, pentest reports, vulnerability writeups, and executive summaries from your work.

plugins.name: threat-modeling
plugins.description: STRIDE / PASTA threat modeling, data flow diagrams, attack trees, and risk-ranked mitigations.

plugins.name: web-app-security
plugins.description: Web application security testing: OWASP Web Top 10 assessment, access-control/IDOR testing, and injection testing.

plugins.name: api-security
plugins.description: API security testing: OWASP API Security Top 10 assessment and object/function-level authorization (BOLA/BFLA) testing.

plugins.name: mobile-security
plugins.description: Mobile app security (Android/iOS): OWASP MASVS review and MASTG-based testing methodology.

plugins.name: sast-sca
plugins.description: Static analysis (SAST) and software composition analysis (SCA): run/triage code scans, dependency/SBOM analysis, and prioritize findings.

plugins.name: cloud-security
plugins.description: Cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP): posture review, IAM least-privilege review, and misconfiguration scanning.

plugins.name: k8s-security
plugins.description: Kubernetes security: cluster review (CIS / 4Cs), RBAC least-privilege audit, and workload/pod hardening (Pod Security Standards).

plugins.name: infrastructure-security
plugins.description: Infrastructure security: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security review, host/OS hardening against CIS benchmarks, and secrets-management review.

plugins.name: detection-engineering
plugins.description: Detection engineering: detection-as-code rule development (Sigma/YARA/KQL/SPL), ATT&CK coverage gap analysis, and hypothesis-driven threat hunting.

plugins.name: dfir
plugins.description: Digital forensics & incident response: drive the IR lifecycle (NIST 800-61 / PICERL), forensic evidence triage and timelining, and IOC development.

plugins.name: threat-intelligence
plugins.description: Cyber threat intelligence: run the CTI lifecycle with structured analysis, enrich and pivot on IOCs, and profile threat actors/campaigns (ATT&CK, Diamond Model).

plugins.name: network-security
plugins.description: Network security: authorized network penetration testing, segmentation/firewall review, and protocol/service security assessment.

plugins.name: osint
plugins.description: Open-source intelligence: external footprinting & attack-surface mapping, exposure discovery (leaks/exposed assets), and people/social recon.

plugins.name: llm-security
plugins.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 assessment, prompt-injection testing, and threat modeling for LLM, RAG, and agentic AI systems.

plugins.name: rag-security
plugins.description: Security for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: pipeline review, retrieval/data poisoning testing, and vector-store isolation checks.

plugins.name: agentic-ai-security
plugins.description: Security for autonomous, tool-using AI agents: review, tool-permission audit, and autonomy-boundary testing for excessive agency.

plugins.name: multimodal-security
plugins.description: Security for multimodal AI: cross-modal injection testing (image/audio/document) and input-handling review across modalities.

plugins.name: ai-safety
plugins.description: AI safety (distinct from security): harm modeling, safety evaluations, responsible red-teaming, bias/fairness, guardrail review, and responsible-AI governance.

plugins.name: ai-safety-engineer
plugins.description: AI safety engineer role bundle: build and operationalize safeguards (evals-in-CI, guardrails, monitoring, safety cases, governance). Auto-installs the ai-safety stack.

plugins.name: responsible-ai-officer
plugins.description: Responsible-AI governance role: AI use-case intake & risk-tiering, oversight, documentation, and compliance (NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act / ISO 42001). Auto-installs the ai-safety stack.

plugins.name: pentester
plugins.description: Pentester role bundle: recon workflow, methodology-driven testing, and engagement reporting. Auto-installs its core/domain stack (osint, web, network, threat-modeling).

plugins.name: red-team
plugins.description: Red-team role bundle: objectives-based adversary emulation aligned to real threat-actor TTPs (ATT&CK), from recon to impact. Auto-installs its offensive + intel stack.

plugins.name: blue-team
plugins.description: Blue-team role bundle: threat-informed defense across detection, response, hunting, and intel, plus purple-team validation. Auto-installs the defensive stack.

plugins.name: soc-siem
plugins.description: SOC / SIEM operations role bundle: alert triage, monitoring, enrichment, and tiered escalation. Auto-installs the defensive stack.

plugins.name: security-architect
plugins.description: Security architect role bundle: secure-by-design architecture and design review, threat modeling, control selection, and trust-boundary analysis. Auto-installs its core stack.

plugins.name: security-analyst
plugins.description: Security analyst role bundle: investigation and analysis (T2/T3) — correlate telemetry, enrich with intel, reconstruct timelines, and reach evidence-backed verdicts. Auto-installs the defensive stack.

plugins.name: security-engineer
plugins.description: Security engineer role bundle: build and harden — DevSecOps, secure CI/CD pipelines, control implementation, and remediation across code, cloud, and infrastructure. Auto-installs its stack.

plugins.name: ciso-toolkit
plugins.description: CISO executive toolkit: security strategy & roadmap, cyber-risk quantification, and board/executive decks. Auto-installs reporting, diagramming, and threat-modeling.

plugins.name: cto-security
plugins.description: CTO security advisor: secure-by-design at scale (paved roads, guardrails, enablement) and technology-risk assessment for strategic decisions. Auto-installs threat-modeling, diagramming, reporting.

plugins.name: genai-suite
plugins.description: Domain suite: one-shot install of the GenAI / AI-security plugins (LLM, RAG, agentic, multimodal).

plugins.name: cloud-suite
plugins.description: Domain suite: one-shot install of cloud-security, k8s-security, and infrastructure-security.

plugins.name: appsec-suite
plugins.description: Domain suite: one-shot install of the appsec plugins (web, API, mobile, SAST/SCA).

plugins.name: ai-safety-suite
plugins.description: Trustworthy-AI suite: pairs AI safety with the full GenAI security stack (ai-safety + genai-suite).

plugins.name: blueops-suite
plugins.description: Defensive operations suite: one-shot install of detection-engineering, dfir, and threat-intelligence.
